summary: Within days of the address, allies file the bills that put its promises into writing.
realLife: One state senator said the same day that he and a House member had filed bills to put the governor's requests into law. In another state a governor sent nearly 340 bills to the Legislature days after the address, including a visitor fee and an amnesty for short-term rentals that return to long-term housing, and some bills were in competition with others already filed.
sources: Talk Business & Politics (Arkansas), 'Legislators react to Gov. Hutchinson's State of the State address', January 12, 2021: https://talkbusiness.net/2021/01/legislators-react-to-gov-hutchinsons-state-of-the-state-address/
Honolulu Star-Advertiser via Hawaii Tribune-Herald (Hawaii), 'Almost 340 bills are introduced to Hawaii lawmakers by the governor', January 27, 2024: https://www.hawaiitribune-herald.com/?p=315855
